measurement_environment.note: model-side and OFFICIAL-renderer measurements only: every number here is the official gymnasium-robotics renderer driven through the swm FetchWrapper at 224x224, never a stable-envs frame. stable-envs Fetch frames need mujoco_warp on cuda and are measured on Oscar -- see gpu_evidence.json and pixel_parity.json.

material_unbind_side_effect.what: FetchWrapper._apply_visual_variations sets model.geom_matid[i] = -1 on the table, floor and object geoms the first time ANY of its six visual leaves is active, permanently for that env. Those geoms then render at the compiler default 0.5 grey instead of their material colours (table 0.93, floor 0.2, object 0.2).
material_unbind_side_effect.note: the measured row is camera.angle_delta held at its OWN default -- a leaf that is dead and changes nothing else -- so the whole difference is the unbind. DEFAULT_VARIATIONS activates five visual leaves, so a plain reset() always triggers it.

swm_leaf_defaults_are_not_the_official_a.what: table.color 0.3 vs the model's 0.93, object.color (0.8,0.1,0.1) vs 0.2 grey, background.color 0.1 vs floor 0.2 plus a textured skybox, light.intensity 0.7 vs the model's light_diffuse 0.8, agent.start_position (1.3418,0.7491) vs the env's own initial gripper xy.

variation_values_must_be_ndarray.what: options['variation_values'] entries reach _apply_visual_variations unconverted; a plain Python list for background.color raises AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'astype'.

check_mapping_reads_unwrapped.what: stable_envs.compat.worldmodel.check_mapping reads gymnasium.make(swm_id).unwrapped.variation_space. FetchWrapper is a gym.Wrapper around MujocoFetchEnv, so .unwrapped is the official env and carries no variation_space: check_mapping raises AttributeError for all twelve Fetch ids. stable_envs.compat.variation_maps.fetch.swm_variation_space walks the wrapper chain instead. A one-line fix in a shared file this workstream does not own.

gymnasium_robotics_enum_membership.what: gymnasium_robotics.utils.mujoco_utils.set_joint_q{pos,vel} / get_joint_q{pos,vel} assert model.jnt_type[i] in (mjJNT_HINGE, mjJNT_SLIDE). With numpy 2.5.3 the needle is an np.int32 and mujoco's pybind11 mjtJoint.__eq__ returns NotImplemented for it, so `in` is False where `==` is True, and every Fetch env fails to construct. Observed on macOS/arm64 with mujoco 3.12.0 + gymnasium-robotics 1.4.2 + numpy 2.5.3; worked around in a scratchpad probe shim only, nothing in this repository is changed for it. Oscar's se-s3b-fetch311 (mujoco 3.11.0) is unaffected.

escalation_candidates.what: swm recolours the floor geoms AND the skybox texture; we render the floor half exactly and the skybox not at all. Measured split: floor 9.2-9.4% of the frame, skybox a further 61.7-73.0%.
escalation_candidates.feasible: yes, mechanically: overwrite mat/tex data per value. Cost: mujoco_warp uploads textures when a render context is built, so a per-value skybox is one render context per value, which this repo's renderer rules forbid scaling. stable_envs/envs/fetch.py:make_variation_space records the same reason for not making the skybox a knob at all.
escalation_candidates.decision_for: coordinator / Sami (plan section 4: an SWM leaf declared partly unsupported where an implementation appears feasible and semantically required)

agent.start_position.reason: a reset distribution in swm; a dimension of our STATE (the arm's qpos)

background.color.reason: renamed -> floor.color. swm's background is the floor geoms AND the skybox texture; we render the floor half exactly and the skybox not at all

camera.angle_delta.reason: the wrapper rotates model.cam_pos for the 4 MODEL cameras; MujocoFetchEnv renders through the FREE camera from DEFAULT_CAMERA_CONFIG and never selects one

goal.start_position.reason: a reset distribution in swm; state dimensions goal_x/goal_y/goal_z

light.intensity.reason: scaled -> light.diffuse, ours = theirs * 1.25, because swm assigns the light's diffuse absolutely and ours multiplies the model's own 0.8

object.color.reason: reach.xml compiles neither block_mat nor puck_mat onto a geom, so the wrapper's write lands on an empty geom list

rendering.transparent_arm.reason: mujoco_warp's render kernel reads color[0..2] and packs a constant 255: no alpha path. Same mechanism that makes this family hide the 4 translucent robot0:mocap markers

table.color.reason: identical path and units; writes the same table geom (geom 22, material table_mat)

ours_only_reasons.goal.color: the red target sphere's colour; swm exposes no goal appearance, only goal.start_position
ours_only_reasons.arm.color: the five robot0:blue links; swm's only arm leaf is rendering.transparent_arm, which is an alpha and not a colour
ours_only_reasons.camera.distance_scale: a working camera knob; swm's camera.angle_delta is dead upstream (see swm_only) and has no distance term at all
ours_only_reasons.camera.azimuth_delta: a working camera knob; see camera.distance_scale
ours_only_reasons.camera.elevation_delta: a working camera knob; see camera.distance_scale
